name: Howmeify
shortDescription: A house rental management system for managing properties, tenants, and property owners.
description: Howmeify is a house rental management system developed as a final-year diploma project. The system focuses on managing rental properties, tenants, property owners, and related property information.

name: AimCrypt
shortDescription: A steganography application for encoding and decoding hidden information.
description: AimCrypt is a steganography project developed during diploma studies for general-purpose use. The project focuses on hiding and extracting information using a web-based interface.

name: Fooddify
shortDescription: An online food ordering system developed during a full-stack development internship.
description: Fooddify is an online food ordering system developed during the SoftSpire Solutions internship. The project uses React.js, Node.js, MySQL, and REST APIs to provide an integrated full-stack food ordering experience.

name: GSTNest
shortDescription: An invoice generator with GST calculation developed during a Java full-stack internship.
description: GSTNest is an invoice generation application developed during the Sumago Infotech internship. It uses Java, Thymeleaf, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MySQL to generate and manage invoices with GST calculations.

name: Unit Calculator
shortDescription: An Android unit calculator application developed using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
description: Unit Calculator is an Android application developed for general-purpose unit conversion and calculation using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Android development technologies.

name: Digital Shop
shortDescription: An Android shopping application developed using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
description: Digital Shop is an Android application developed using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Android technologies. The project was developed as a production-oriented application while remaining under development and may not be officially published.
